review_comment: The code fetches RSS feed URLs via urllib2.urlopen without validating the destination, allowing SSRF attacks to internal network resources. The href parameter from external RSS feeds flows directly to the network fetch operation. Implement URL validation to restrict allowed schemes and destinations, such as validating URLs against an allowlist of permitted domains and blocking requests to internal IP ranges.
